description: A single-page checkout that forces account creation, uses placeholder-only labels, asks for unneeded fields, and signals errors only by red borders plus a generic top message, with analytics showing early abandonment on mobile; a correct answer prioritizes guest checkout, field cuts, visible labels and accessible inline errors, grounded in the data and WCAG.

ui-ux-designer.task: Our checkout is in `{fixture}/checkout.html` and its analytics are in `{fixture}/analytics.md`. Recommend design changes to improve completion, in priority order. You cannot write files in this run, so put your complete design recommendation in your final message.

rubricPoints.requirement: Recommends guest checkout (account creation optional or offered after the order), citing the 'didn't want another account' feedback and/or the 52% of exits before any field is typed in.

Recommends removing or making optional unneeded fields, naming at least two of fax, date of birth (no age-restricted products), confirm password, or duplicate billing address (for example, a 'same as shipping' default).
Recommends persistent visible labels instead of placeholder-only labels, citing an accessibility reason (placeholders vanish on input and are not reliable labels; WCAG 3.3.2 or 1.3.1).

Recommends field-level error text that names the problem and how to fix it, programmatically tied to the field and not conveyed by red color alone (WCAG 1.4.1 and/or 3.3.1), with focus or scroll moved to the first error.
